text.lede_legs: The two chosen mean-reversion, two noise-band and two squeeze-breakout strategies
text.sleeve_desc: $166,667 of a $1,000,000 account for all six together (a third per family), or half the account each within a pair
text.sleeve_small: a $166,667 sleeve can't hold one whole ES contract
text.holdout_caveat: Each pair was frozen before its own holdout test and is unchanged here. But all three holdout results had been seen before this page combined them (the squeeze pair's #50 roughly broke even), so this view is a description, not a fresh test: don't use it to pick a mix.
text.val_caveat: Not clean for any family: every pair was picked with its 2023–2024 results in view (the noise-band and squeeze pairs directly on them). It shows how they held up, not proof.
